Title: SQL Server
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/databasespecific/overview-9
Content: Microsoft SQL Server is a relational database management system. The JDBC connector can connect to a SQLServer database to pull structure and lineage metadata. To leverage these capabilities, solidatus.jdbc.driver must be set to sqlserver. For SQL parsing related features solidatus.jdbc.dialect must be set to sqlserver.
Title: Troubleshooting
Link: https://docs.solidatus.com/solidatus-2026.1/connectors/connector-specific-documentation/solidatus-jdbc-connectors/troubleshooting
Content: SQL Server/AzureSQL JDBC driver is using java.util.logging hence there is additional setup to enable debug logging for the driver.

This should only be enabled for debugging complex connectivity issue as it incurs performance overhead

Create a logging.properties file with handlers property below

handlers=org.slf4j.bridge.SLF4JBridgeHandler

Add JVM option -Djava.util.logging.config.file=/path/logging.properties to command line
Add logging setting for JDBC driver to command line

--logging.level.com.microsoft.sqlserver.jdbc="debug"

Restart connector agent or re-run command line with the change above
